textes.Affiches, savon et lavage des mains : co: Posters, soap and hand washing: contagion ×0.8, and ×0.7 for waterborne diseases.
textes.Après %s, les médecins le répètent : san: After %s, doctors keep saying it: without sewers or clean water, it will be back.
textes.Arrêtés sanitaires du maire. Les mesures: The mayor's health orders. Measures marked ⏳ are lifted one week after the epidemic ends.
textes.Aucun lit d'hôpital : les cas graves meu: No hospital beds: serious cases die more often. Build a hospital (Build → Services), or a field hospital in an emergency.
textes.Aucune épidémie en ce moment. Profitez-e: No epidemic right now. Enjoy it, it never lasts.
textes.Avis à la population : faites bouillir l: Public notice: boil your water! Kettles are whistling all over town.
textes.Campagne d'hygiène : « Lavez-vous les ma: Hygiene campaign: "Wash your hands!" The soap maker is making a fortune.
textes.Campagne de vaccination contre la %s : l: Vaccination campaign against %s: doctors take out their syringes, children their screams.
textes.Campagne de vaccination contre la %s ter: Vaccination campaign against %s complete: %d doses, %d %% coverage.
textes.Campagne de vaccination contre le Covid-: Covid-19 vaccination campaign: online bookings, queues outside the gym.
textes.Confinement ! Les rues se vident, les bo: Lockdown! The streets empty, bakeries stay open. Record flour sales.
textes.Conseil : faire bouillir l'eau (Mesures): Tip: boil the water (Measures); in the long run, sewers and drinking water.
textes.Conseil : quarantaine des malades (Mesur: Tip: quarantine the sick (Measures), and vaccinate if a vaccine exists.
textes.Depuis le docteur Snow et sa pompe de Br: Ever since Dr Snow and his Broad Street pump: waterborne contagion ÷2.5.
textes.Deux doses dans l'enfance et la rougeole: Two doses in childhood and measles becomes one of grandma's stories.
textes.Doses possibles par jour : %d (plus d'hô: Doses per day: %d (more hospitals and doctors, more doses). Without a mandate, %d %% of residents refuse at this time.
textes.Fin de la quarantaine : les familles res: Quarantine over: families come back out, a little pale.
textes.Fin des masques obligatoires. Les sourir: Masks no longer required. Smiles are back.
textes.Fleming découvre la pénicilline… en oubl: Fleming discovers penicillin… by forgetting to wash his culture dishes.
textes.Grandes épidémies de l'histoire à leur d: Great epidemics of history on their date
textes.Hambourg boit l'eau de l'Elbe sans la fi: Hamburg drinks unfiltered Elbe water, and cholera is ravaging the city.
textes.Hôpital de campagne sous toile : des lit: A field hospital under canvas: beds for serious cases, even without a hospital.
textes.John Snow montre que le choléra vient de: John Snow shows that cholera comes from contaminated water.
textes.Koch découvre le bacille de la tuberculo: Koch discovers the tuberculosis bacillus, then the cholera one (1884).
textes.L'OMS déclare la variole éradiquée de la: The WHO declares smallpox eradicated from the planet.
textes.L'anatoxine de Gaston Ramon. Le croup ne: Gaston Ramon's toxoid. Parents no longer fear croup.
textes.L'eau du réseau est désormais chlorée. G: Mains water is now chlorinated. Swimming-pool taste guaranteed, fewer germs.
textes.La guerre et la variole avancent ensembl: War and smallpox advance together. The vaccinated sleep soundly.
textes.La plupart boivent l'eau du puits. Un ca: Most people drink well water. A water intake or waterworks and pipes (O) change everything.
textes.La vaccination contre la %s devient obli: Vaccination against %s becomes mandatory. An anti-vaccination league meets at the café: all four of them.
textes.La vaccination contre la %s n'est plus o: Vaccination against %s is no longer mandatory.
textes.La vaccine de Jenner, tirée du pis des v: Jenner's vaccine, taken from cows' udders. Parisians find the idea odd, but it works.
textes.Le choléra est de retour en Europe. Les: Cholera is back in Europe. Doctors argue: miasma or dirty water?
textes.Le choléra frappe Toulon et Marseille. R: Cholera strikes Toulon and Marseille. Robert Koch has just identified its bacillus.
textes.Le choléra revient par les ports. Les ég: Cholera returns through the ports. Will the new sewers be ready?
textes.Le choléra, parti des bords du Gange, tr: Cholera, which set out from the banks of the Ganges, is crossing Europe. People say it will be here before summer.
textes.Le lazaret est démonté. Les tentes parti: The field hospital is taken down. The tents will go to the next circus.
textes.Le sérum antidiphtérique de Roux : on gu: Roux's diphtheria serum: croup can finally be cured.
textes.Le vaccin de Jonas Salk. Fini les poumon: Jonas Salk's vaccine. No more iron lungs.
textes.Les antibiotiques pour tous : typhoïde e: Antibiotics for all: typhoid and cholera can be treated.
textes.Les catastrophes sont désactivées (Admin: Disasters are turned off (Admin F10): the calendar is waiting.
textes.Les hôpitaux sont débordés : %d hospital: Hospitals are overwhelmed: %d patients for %d beds.
textes.Les malades et leur foyer ne sortent plu: The sick and their household stay indoors. Contagion outside the home: ÷3.
textes.Les écoles ferment. Les enfants hurlent: Schools close. Children scream with joy, parents less so.
textes.Les écoles rouvrent. Les cartables avaie: Schools reopen. The satchels had gathered dust.
textes.Loi sur la santé publique : vaccin antiv: Public health law: mandatory smallpox vaccine, chlorine in the water.
textes.Masques obligatoires en ville. On se rec: Masks are mandatory in town. People recognise each other by their eyebrows.
textes.Moins de la moitié des habitants ont des: Fewer than half of residents have sewers: cholera and typhoid would have a feast. Lay a sewer network (O) and a treatment plant.
textes.On peut de nouveau boire l'eau sans la f: Water is safe to drink again without boiling. The kettles get a rest.
textes.Partie à l'époque actuelle : le calendri: Game set in the present: the calendar only plays if the game starts in the past (Starting year, Admin F10).
textes.Pas un seul mort pendant l'épidémie de %: Not a single death during the %s epidemic. The mayor takes the credit, and so do the doctors, each for themselves.
textes.Pasteur et la pasteurisation : les micro: Pasteur and pasteurisation: germs exist, and they can be killed.
textes.Plus de contagion à l'école. Les parents: No more contagion at school. Parents, though, are stuck with the kids.
textes.Protège à moitié. Contre la typhoïde, l': Half protection. Against typhoid, clean water is still the best weapon.
textes.Quarantaine : les malades ne quittent pl: Quarantine: the sick no longer leave their homes. Neighbours leave soup on the doorstep.
textes.Semmelweis prouve qu'il suffit de se lav: Semmelweis proves that washing your hands is enough to save women in childbirth.
textes.Un lazaret est monté sous des tentes. Le: A field hospital goes up under tents. Comfort is rustic, but patients get care.
textes.Un médecin de Londres, John Snow, accuse: A London doctor, John Snow, blames a water pump for killing an entire neighbourhood.
A new coronavirus is spreading in China. The toilet paper aisles are starting to tremble.
textes.Un peu de chlore dans l'eau du réseau :: A little chlorine in mains water: no more germs at the tap. The water tastes like a swimming pool.
textes.Une grippe partie de Hong Kong arrive pa: A flu from Hong Kong arrives by plane. Hospitals are getting ready.
textes.Une grippe étrange circule dans les tran: A strange flu is going round the trenches. The censors call it "Spanish", Spain protests.
textes.Une nouvelle grippe venue d'Asie fait le: A new flu from Asia goes round the world in a few months.
textes.Vaccin contre la %s disponible et peu de: Vaccine against %s available and few people vaccinated (%d %%).
textes.Vaccin à ARN messager, mis au point en m: Messenger RNA vaccine, developed in under a year. The fridge has to be very, very cold.
textes.choléra et typhoïde passent par les puit: cholera and typhoid spread through contaminated wells and poorly treated water: sewers, a treatment plant and drinking water stop them; in an emergency, boil the water
textes.datés (variole 1800, diphtérie 1923, gri: dated (smallpox 1800, diphtheria 1923, flu 1945, polio 1955, measles 1963, Covid-19 2021): a campaign paid per dose, or a mandate; some residents refuse; above 90 % vaccinated, the disease no longer takes hold
textes.panneau Santé publique (menu Infos) : ép: Public health panel (Info menu): current epidemic, housing hygiene (drinking water, sewers), hospital beds, advice; Vaccines, Measures and History tabs
textes.partie commencée dans le passé : choléra: game started in the past: cholera in 1832, 1849, 1854…, smallpox in 1870, Spanish flu in 1918, flus of 1957 and 1968, Covid-19 in 2020; a rumour reaches the paper first (F7 → History to turn the calendar off)
textes.quarantaine, écoles fermées, lazaret, ca: quarantine, school closures, field hospital, hygiene campaign (1847), boiled water (1854), chlorinated water (1902), masks and lockdown (1918): daily cost, satisfaction; lifted automatically a week after the epidemic
textes.À refaire chaque année : le virus change: Needs repeating every year: the virus changes its coat every winter.
textes.Écoles, bureaux et usines au ralenti : c: Schools, offices and factories slow down: contacts at work ÷4, schools closed. Aid to shops paid by the town.

textes.Boom mondial de la construction : des gr: Global construction boom: cranes everywhere, not a bag of cement in sight. Architects have stopped sleeping.
textes.Carrières, scieries, cimenteries et briq: Quarries, sawmills, cement works and brickworks: their time has come. Export your materials.
textes.Choc pétrolier : les pays producteurs fe: Oil shock: producing countries turn off the taps and the barrel soars. Drivers rediscover their bikes.
textes.Guerre commerciale : les grandes puissan: Trade war: the great powers fight with tariffs. Customs officers are working overtime.
textes.Importer coûte 30 % de plus et moins de: Imports cost 30 % more and fewer trucks cross the border. Make what you can locally, and trade between your towns.
textes.Inflation galopante : tout augmente, sau: Runaway inflation: everything goes up except wages (it's always the way).
textes.Krach boursier : les marchés plongent. L: Stock market crash: markets plunge. Traders sell their watches and move back in with their parents.
textes.L'inflation est maîtrisée : les prix arr: Inflation is under control: prices stop climbing.
textes.La pluie est revenue : les prix agricole: The rain is back: farm prices calm down.
textes.La ruée vers les métaux se termine : les: The metal rush is over: copper prices come back down.
textes.Le boom de la construction retombe : les: The construction boom fades: the cranes go back to the depot.
textes.Le pétrole redescend : fin du choc pétro: Oil comes back down: the oil shock is over. The bikes go back in the garage.
textes.Les acheteurs étrangers se font rares :: Foreign buyers are scarce: export deals signed before the crisis keep their price. Sell locally rather than abroad.
textes.Les céréales et le lait se vendent mal :: Grain and milk sell badly: keep them for your factories and shops, and buy what's going cheap abroad.
textes.Les greniers se vident : les prix agrico: The granaries are emptying: farm prices rise again.
textes.Les marchés reprennent des couleurs : le: Markets perk up: the crash is forgotten (until the next one).
textes.Les usines de puces tournent de nouveau: Chip factories are running again: the shortage is over.
textes.Paix commerciale signée : les taxes tomb: Trade peace signed: tariffs fall, customs officers go home.
textes.Pénurie de puces électroniques : même le: Microchip shortage: even smart toasters have to wait their turn.
textes.Ruée vers les métaux : les batteries éle: Metal rush: electric batteries send copper soaring. People are even searching old attics for saucepans.
textes.Récolte record : les greniers débordent: Record harvest: granaries are overflowing all over the world. Wheat is worth nothing, the cows are delighted.
textes.Sécheresse mondiale : les récoltes grill: Global drought: crops are scorching on three continents. The price of a baguette makes the headlines.
textes.Tes fermes valent de l'or : exporte céré: Your farms are worth gold: export grain and oilseeds. Your bakeries and supermarkets will pay more if they import.
textes.Tout coûte plus cher, à l'import comme à: Everything costs more, imports and exports alike. Fixed-price deals signed before the crisis are a bargain for the buyer.
textes.Tu produis du pétrole, du gaz ou du carb: If you produce oil, gas or fuel, export while it lasts. Otherwise, a fixed-price purchase deal protects your companies and petrol stations.
textes.Une mine de cuivre ou de bauxite rapport: A copper or bauxite mine earns twice as much: open a quarry (P → Mines) if your region has some.
textes.Électronique et voitures neuves coûtent: Electronics and new cars cost much more to import. An electronics factory in town makes big money during the crisis.
textes.chaque marchandise a un cours qui bouge: every good has a price that moves every day; goods in the same family (energy, metals, farming…) move together. Exports and imports trade at today's price; on the map and on the shelves, prices follow it halfway
textes.choc pétrolier, krach, sécheresse mondia: oil shock, crash, global drought, chip shortage, construction boom, inflation, trade war, record harvest, metal rush: they build up, last 1 to 6 months, then fade. F10: crises on or off, calm, normal or volatile market
textes.de vraies villes voisines de ton lieu. E: real cities near your location. They offer to buy or sell so many tonnes a day, at a fixed price, for 30 to 180 days. A trade mission (25,000 €) improves the relationship and brings two offers
textes.la ville qui achète se fournit d'abord c: the buying town gets supplies from the selling town first, at the agreed price; on a friends' map, the other town's mayor must accept. Free trade between two of your countries: no more customs duties

You remain in charge of the town.

textes.Aucun bâtiment de secours. Pose une case: No emergency building. Place a fire station, a police station or a hospital (Build → Services), beside a road.
textes.Aucun bâtiment n'a encore besoin du rése: No building needs the network yet.
textes.Aucun bâtiment où déclencher un incendie: No building to start a fire in.

textes.Aucun dépôt de collecte : personne ne ra: No collection depot: nobody collects the bins (Build → Waste).
textes.Aucun employé : il faut des habitants sa: No employees: unemployed residents are needed in town.
textes.Aucun enclos. « Tracer » : clic à chaque: No enclosure. "Draw": click at each corner then click the first point (or Enter); drag for a rectangle.
textes.Aucun fournisseur de %s (ni sur la carte: No supplier of %s (neither on the map nor by import)
textes.Aucun gisement assez riche ici (%s : %d: No deposit rich enough here (%s: %d %%, %d %% needed). Open the resources map (P).
No youngsters at the academy yet.
Nowhere in town for their hobbies.
textes.Aucun meuble posé · %d meubles dans la b: No furniture placed · %d items in the bible
textes.Aucun modèle pour l'instant. Dans l'Atel: No model yet. In the Workshop, build a building with walls and floors, then Interior tab (4) →
textes.Aucun nid-de-poule n'a été maltraité pen: No potholes were harmed during development.
textes.Aucun nouveau modèle dans le dossier d'é: No new model in the exchange folder.
textes.Aucun parc. Pose une Entrée du parc au b: No park. Place a Park entrance next to a road (Build → Leisure park), then attractions, stalls and toilets within 250 m behind it.
textes.Aucun parking. Construis-en avec Lignes: No car parks. Build some with Lines (L) > Car park.
textes.Aucun poste libre pour l'instant : les b: No free position for now: finished buildings (farm, shops, school…) offer some.
textes.Aucun problème sérieux. Profites-en : ça: No serious problems. Make the most of it: it never lasts.
textes.Aucun site. Ouvre Construire (B) → Produ: No sites. Open Build (B) → Production: farm, mine, sawmill, mill… and Commerce: bakery, mini-market, petrol station…
textes.Aucun stade en ville. Construis-en un (C: No stadium in town. Build one (Build, B → Sport): 11 large stadiums and the football pitch. Each stadium has its club, which plays every other Saturday or Sunday during the season (mid-July to the end of May).
No busy sections. Everything is flowing.
textes.Aucun véhicule de ce genre pour ces stat: No vehicle of this kind for these stations.
textes.Aucun véhicule ne peut desservir ces sta: No vehicle can serve these stations.
textes.Aucun véhicule ne peut partir en interve: No vehicle can go out on a call.
None. The town owes nothing to anyone.
textes.Aucune attraction : pose-en à moins de 2: No attractions: place some within 250 m of the entrance (Build → Leisure park).
textes.Aucune attraction créée dans cette parti: No attractions created in this game. Start with the Roller coasters or Water rides tab.
textes.Aucune benne dehors. Les tournées parten: No bin lorry out. Rounds leave the depots between 5 am and noon, Monday to Saturday, when the bins fill up.
textes.Aucune carrière ni mine. Construire (B): No quarries or mines. Build (B) → Production: quarry, sand and gravel pit, clay pit, open-pit mine, underground mine, salt mine.
textes.Aucune création pour l'instant. Construi: No creation yet. Build with the Free editor, then “Save” and click and drag around your construction.
textes.Aucune ferme sur la carte. Construis-en: No farm on the map. Build one: Build (B) → Production → Grain farm, Livestock farm, Dairy farm, Pig farm…
textes.Aucune ferme à moins de %.1f km : constr: No farm within %.1f km: first build a farm (Production category).
textes.Aucune file dessinée : les visiteurs att: No queue drawn: visitors wait in rows in front of the entrance.
textes.Aucune grande région connue à moins de %: No major known region within %d km. Small local deposits are still possible: look at the map.
textes.Aucune installation. Pose un dépôt de co: No facilities. Place a collection depot and a landfill next to a road (Build → Waste).
textes.Aucune ligne. Crée-en avec le panneau Li: No lines. Create some with the Lines panel (L).
textes.Aucune machine : la ferme loue à la jour: No machines: the farm rents what it needs by the day.
textes.Aucune partie sauvegardée pour l'instant: No saved game yet. A town without archives is a town without worries… until the power cut. In game: F5 or Esc > Save.
textes.Aucune place libre dans une école : cons: No free school places: build a school (B → Public services).
textes.Aucune pour l'instant : pose %s dans le: None yet: place %s from the Build panel, Networks category.
No town found in the index.
textes.Automatique : le temps suit le climat ré: Automatic: the weather follows the real climate of the place and the season.
textes.Autoroute trop courte : il faut au moins: Motorway too short: at least %d m is needed on each side of the bridge for the slip roads.

textes.Avion ancien suspendu: Old plane hanging from the ceiling
textes.B : Construire → Espaces publics, Loisir: B: Build → Public spaces, Leisure or Sport

textes.Bac à sable : tu es l'admin de ta partie: Sandbox: you are the admin of your game.
textes.Bacs jaunes et verre pour tous, contrôle: Yellow bins and glass for everyone, checks and fines for bad sorters.
textes.Bain bouillonnant surélevé, banquette to: Raised hot tub, bench all around, teak edge.
textes.Balles de tri → papier et carton, granul: Sorted bales → paper and cardboard, plastic pellets, steel. Delivered to the town's factories.
textes.Ballons gonflés à l'hélium. Un sur dix f: Helium balloons. One in ten ends up in the sky, before even reaching the exit.
textes.Bals, valses et une moustache impeccable: Balls, waltzes and an impeccable moustache.
textes.Bancs de montage : la post-production du: Editing desks: the film's post-production happens here.
textes.Bancs en planches sur structure métalliq: Plank benches on a metal frame, like at the village stadium.
textes.Bancs et poteaux le long des routes, pon: Benches and posts along the roads, jetties and boats near buildings, rocks and wild ducks.
Benches, parasols, bins and a tree. Tired visitors get their strength back there.
textes.Banque de modèles : bâtiments personnali: Model bank: customized and furnished buildings
textes.Barres bleues : pluie · orange : tempéra: Blue bars: rain · orange: maximum temperature · light blue: minimum · white: snow.
textes.Barrière de sécurité devant la scène: Safety barrier in front of the stage
textes.Bas de caisse noir, haut blanc, gyrophar: Black lower body, white top, red beacon.
textes.Bassin : glisser pour creuser un plan d': Pool: drag to dig a body of water (radius %d m).
textes.Bassin carrelé de 1,50 m, margelle en pi: 1.50 m tiled pool, stone coping. The ground is dug out underneath.
textes.Bassin de 2 m de fond, machine à vagues: 2 m deep pool, wave machine and a backdrop painted as a horizon. Shipwrecks, pirates and storms.
textes.Bassin de jardin à rebord de pierre et j: Garden pond with a stone rim and a fountain in the middle.
25 m outdoor pool and changing rooms.
textes.Bassin sportif de 25 m (ou 50 m) : coulo: 25 m (or 50 m) sports pool: 2.50 m lanes, lane ropes, starting blocks.
textes.Bassins de rétention : %d (chacun −25 %%: Retention basins: %d (each −25 %% water height within 3 km).
textes.Bassins où les eaux usées s'épurent tout: Ponds where wastewater purifies itself (400 m³ per day, no electricity). For a village.
textes.Bassins pétroliers réels (golfe Persique: Real oil basins (Persian Gulf, North Sea, Aquitaine…).
textes.Bassins salifères réels (Lorraine, Jura,: Real salt basins (Lorraine, Jura, Cheshire, Wieliczka, Salzkammergut…).
textes.Beaucoup d'habitants cherchent du travai: Many residents are looking for work, and they're starting to wonder what the mayor is for.
textes.Beethoven, Brahms et la toux de l'entrac: Beethoven, Brahms and the interval coughing.
textes.Benne-tasseuse de 26 t et ses deux ripeu: 26 t compactor truck and its two bin men, about 8 t of rubbish per round.
textes.Bennes : %d dehors sur %d · éboueurs de: Bin lorries: %d out of %d · collectors on duty: %s
textes.Besoin des habitants · vendu hier · prod: Residents' needs · sold yesterday · produced yesterday · in stock
textes.Bien couvert : hôpital à moins de 30 min: Well covered: hospital within 30 min by car and one bed per 333 residents (3 ‰).
textes.Bien couvert : intervention en moins de: Well covered: response in under 10 min and one officer per %d residents.
textes.Billetterie (indispensable), bar, vestia: Box office (essential), bar, cloakroom, posters, chandelier.
textes.Billetterie (indispensable), vestiaire,: Ticket office (essential), cloakroom, shop, café, toilets.
textes.Billetterie, bornes, confiserie et pop-c: Box office, kiosks, confectionery and popcorn, illuminated posters.
textes.Billetterie, vestiaire, plan, bancs : là: Ticket office, cloakroom, map, benches: where the visit begins.

textes.Blanche à bandes bleue et rouge, gyropha: White with blue and red stripes, blue beacons on the roof.
textes.Bleu nuit à bandes blanches : la sécurit: Midnight blue with white stripes: security for the countryside and small towns.
textes.Bloc opératoire et quarantaine. Sans ell: Operating theatre and quarantine. Without it, a country vet comes by twice a week.
textes.Bloc percé d'un arc en plein cintre de 1: Block pierced by a 1 m round arch (arcades).
textes.Blocs de 1 m façon jeu de cubes : formes: 1 m blocks like a building-block game: shapes, slopes, doors and windows in blocks, for bulk and details.
textes.Blocs de 64 × 64 m affichés : %d · T: 64 × 64 m blocks shown: %d   ·   Elevation tiles: %d in memory
textes.Bois → pâte à papier, papier, carton et: Wood → pulp, paper, cardboard and packaging.
textes.Bon marché, presque invisible. Les herbi: Cheap, almost invisible. Herbivores respect it after the first try.
textes.Bondé : %d min d'attente en plus. Ajoute: Packed: %d min of extra waiting. Add vehicles (Lines panel).
1 m ball (decoration, top of a pillar).
textes.Bouées rondes de huit places qui tournen: Round eight-seat rafts spinning through the rapids. Nobody comes out dry.
textes.Bouées à moteur et pistolets à eau. Le p: Motorized rings and water pistols. The wettest pilot is rarely the one you'd expect.
textes.Boys band. Les cris commencent avant le: Boy band. The screaming starts before the concert.
Modular black box in concrete and glass. New works, dance and plays that spark debate in the café opposite.
textes.Branche la ville sur le grand gazoduc :: Connects the town to the main gas pipeline: up to 30 MW of heat. Gas is bought at €0.05 per kWh by the town and resold to residents.
textes.Branche trop courte pour un giratoire de: Branch too short for a roundabout of %d m radius.
textes.Bravo, Monsieur le Maire (ou Madame) : l: Well done, Mr (or Madam) Mayor: the demo ends here, but not your town. Look at your report, then keep playing as long as you like.
textes.Break allongé des pompes funèbres : il e: Long funeral estate car: it carries the coffin, the procession follows.
textes.Bretelles d'autoroute : on s'insère en c: Motorway slip roads: you merge by giving way, you exit without slowing others
textes.Bruit chez les habitants : %d dB le jour: Noise at residents' homes: %d dB by day, %d dB at night%s
textes.Brûle 300 t d'ordures par jour et en tir: Burns 300 t of rubbish per day and generates electricity from it (about 7 MW). Pollutes the air.
textes.Budget du foyer par mois : revenus %s ·: Household budget per month: income %s · rent %s · shopping %s%s%s
Production offices and two sound stages.
textes.Bureaux de production, deux grands plate: Production offices, two large sound stages and an old-style water tower. Films are shot here (Shows menu → Studios).
textes.Bureaux de production, un grand plateau: Production offices, a large sound stage with its set, a green screen stage, the editing room, dressing rooms, the costume workshop and the set workshop.
textes.Butoir de fin de voie, à poser au bout d: Buffer stop for the end of the track, to place at the end of the rails.
textes.Bâtiment %s de %s m : porte de plain-pie: Building %s of %s m: door at ground level.
textes.Bâtiment modélisé dans Blender : ses cou: Building modelled in Blender: its colours can change, its shape stays that of the model.
textes.Bâtiments et zonage seulement sur le ter: Buildings and zoning only on the territory of your villages
textes.Bâtis, gère, et explique au conseil muni: Build, manage, and explain to the town council why the bridge leads into a field.
textes.Bûcherons, débardeuses et piles de grume: Lumberjacks, skidders and log piles. Place in or near a forest.
textes.C'est l'hiver : pense aux chasse-neige e: It's winter: think about snowploughs and salt. Jumpers come out of the wardrobes.
textes.C'est l'été : moissons de juillet, pisci: It's summer: July harvests, full swimming pools and barbecues. Watch out for drought.
textes.C'est le bon moment pour préparer la sui: It's the right time to prepare what's next: new districts, transport, services.
textes.C'est le bon moment pour une décision im: It's the right time for an unpopular but necessary decision, if one is needed.
textes.C'est le personnage principal d'un autre: This is another player's main character: only they decide their life.
This is another player's main character.
Red phone box with small panes.
textes.Cachets et préparation payés tout de sui: Fees and preparation paid right away, the rest during filming.
textes.Caisse dans le rouge : « %s » abrogé à %: Funds in the red: “%s” repealed in %s (%s per month less).
textes.Caisse dans le rouge depuis %d jours : t: Funds in the red for %d days: prefect's supervision after %d days.
textes.Caisse de %s, la ville que tu gères (ell: Funds of %s, the town you manage (it follows the camera; Shift+P for the country and other towns). Click: budget.
textes.Caisse intermédiaire d'un tramway articu: Middle section of an articulated tram.
textes.Caisses vert bouteille et filet rouge, l: Bottle-green cars with a red line, the first underground lines.
textes.Calcaire et argile → clinker → ciment, d: Limestone and clay → clinker → cement, in a rotary kiln.
textes.Camion de 19 t, lame biaise à l'avant et: 19 t truck, angled blade at the front and salt hopper at the back: it clears and salts at 30 km/h.
textes.Camions de plus de 3,5 t interdits sauf: Trucks over 3.5 t banned except for deliveries; they go around the district.
textes.Campagne en cours : 1er tour %s (résulta: Campaign under way: 1st round %s (results at 8 pm).
textes.Campement : plus que %d jours de vivres: Camp: only %d days of food left for %d founders in tents. Build houses!
textes.Caméra de cinéma ancienne sur trépied: Old film camera on a tripod
textes.Caméra de cinéma numérique sur pied: Digital cinema camera on a stand
textes.Caméra libre. Clique sur la caméra de la: Free camera. Click the camera on the profile (or F) to follow again.
textes.Caméras, affiches, décor de tournage, fa: Cameras, posters, film set, red seats in front of the screen.
textes.Caméras, grue, travelling, fond vert, pr: Cameras, crane, dolly, green screen, spotlights, film sets.
textes.Caméras, projecteurs, affiches, décors,: Cameras, projectors, posters, sets, film costumes, red seats.
textes.Canal, tapis qui monte, chutes et éclabo: Channel, lift belt, drops and splashes. The slide is an open course: it ends with a splash pool.
textes.Canalisation enterrée (visible avec le c: Underground pipe (visible with the Heating layer): links a gas station or boiler plant to the streets.
Underground pipe (visible with the Water layer): links a distant water intake to the road network.
Heatwave: %d days above 33 °C. The heatwave plan is triggered: the elderly are kept hydrated, fans are out of stock.
textes.Canicule : %d °C. La climatisation fait: Heatwave: %d °C. Air conditioning drives up electricity demand, people drink and water more.
textes.Canicule : 35 °C à l'ombre trois jours d: Heatwave: 35 °C in the shade three days in a row. The heatwave plan is triggered, ice cream sellers are making a fortune.
textes.Canicule : la climatisation fait grimper: Heatwave: air conditioning drives up demand (+%d %%).
textes.Capacité : %d véhicules/h par sens · à l: Capacity: %d vehicles/h per direction · at peak: %d veh/h (%s)
textes.Carambolage sur la neige : trois voiture: Pile-up on the snow: three cars and a pizza delivery man, no serious injuries (the pizza is lost).
textes.Carrefour : clic sur un carrefour pour c: Junction: click a junction to change its control (automatic → lights → stop → give way → priority to the right) · Shift + click: roundabout.
textes.Carrelage du bassin, surface du terrain,: Pool tiles, pitch surface, stand steps… in the chosen material and shade (Materials tab).
textes.Carré cédé : il n'appartient plus à aucu: Square given up: it no longer belongs to any village.
textes.Carte entre amis : seul le créateur de l: Friends' map: only the map's creator can change these settings.
textes.Carte mondiale : seul le développeur peu: World map: only the developer can change these settings.
textes.Cartes, écrans et boîtiers → téléphones,: Boards, screens and cases → phones, computers, televisions.
textes.Casiers étanches où l'on enfouit les ord: Sealed cells where rubbish is buried. Cheap, but it pollutes the water and smells bad; once full, it is capped.
textes.Catalogue : %d meubles et objets du mond: Catalogue: %d pieces of furniture and objects from around the world
textes.Catastrophes au hasard (incendies, tempê: Random disasters (fires, storms, epidemics, floods, brush fires)
textes.Cave voûtée, lumière tamisée, piano droi: Vaulted cellar, dim lighting, upright piano. The saxophonist sometimes plays until 2 am.
textes.Ce bâtiment n'accueille ni habitants, ni: This building has no residents, employees or pupils.
textes.Ce carré appartient à %s. Fusionne les d: This square belongs to %s. Merge the two villages to join them.

This youngster is no longer at the academy.
This player is no longer on the market.

textes.Ce parc est d'une propreté presque suspe: This park is almost suspiciously clean.
textes.Ce soir au stade : %s – %s, %d spectateu: Tonight at the stadium: %s – %s, %d spectators expected.
textes.Cellule carrée à bande rouge sur un châs: Square box with a red stripe on a pick-up chassis.
textes.Cendres dispersées au jardin du souvenir: Ashes scattered in the garden of remembrance (%s)
textes.Cent musiciens et un chef qui ne regarde: A hundred musicians and a conductor who never looks at the score.
textes.Cent vingt choristes, dont votre boulang: A hundred and twenty singers, including your baker (tenor).
textes.Centrer la caméra sur la tombe: Centre the camera on the grave
textes.Centrer la vue sur la mairie: Centre the view on the town hall
textes.Centrer la vue sur le campement: Centre the view on the camp
textes.Centrer la vue sur le chantier: Centre the view on the site
textes.Ces deux villages ne se touchent pas : a: These two villages don't touch: expand one up to the other.
textes.Ces réglages seront proposés pour toutes: These settings will be offered for all new games
This by-law is not in force here.
This resident is no longer in town.
textes.Cet îlot appartient à %s : un quartier r: This block belongs to %s: a district stays within its town.
textes.Cet îlot est dans un quartier d'une vill: This block is in a district of a town where you are no longer mayor.
textes.Cet îlot est hors du territoire de tes v: This block is outside your towns' territory.
textes.Cette ferme n'a pas de bâtiment pour les: This farm has no building for animals. Build a livestock farm, a dairy farm (Production) or a farm from the bible: cattle shed, pigsty, henhouse, sheepfold, stud farm, square-courtyard farm…
textes.Cette partie vient d'une version plus ré: This game comes from a newer version of the game.
textes.Cette voie est à %s, dont tu n'es plus l: This road belongs to %s, where you are no longer mayor: its council decides on works.
textes.Chambres froides, foin et légumes en gro: Cold rooms, hay and vegetables in bulk: food costs 40 % less than with a supplier.
textes.Champ de %s : clic glissé pour tracer le: %s field: click and drag to draw the rectangle (near a farm). Esc: stop.
Field too big (100 ha at most).
textes.Champ trop petit (au moins %d m², soit 2: Field too small (at least %d m², i.e. 20 × 20 m).
textes.Champs et bêtes (fermes) → moulin, laite: Fields and animals (farms) → mill, dairy, slaughterhouse, sugar refinery, oil mill → industrial bakery, food factory → trucks → mini-markets, supermarkets, markets, bakeries → residents' plates. With no supplier on the map, trucks fetch goods from outside the map (imports).
textes.Champs et prairies réels, pente, altitud: Real fields and meadows, slope, altitude and climate (latitude).
textes.Changer le régime d'un carrefour : feux,: Change a junction's control: lights, stop, give way, priority to the right
textes.Chantier de %s arrêté : la caisse est vi: Construction of %s stopped: the funds are empty. Borrow in the Budget (M), or wait for this month's taxes; its workers go to other sites.
textes.Chantier de %s lancé : %s, payés au fil: Construction of %s started: %s, paid as work progresses.
textes.Chaque début de saison, de nouveaux jeun: At the start of each season new youngsters arrive, first the town's children who play the sport. At 19, a prospect turns pro or leaves.
textes.Chaque espèce aime un mélange de sols :: Each species likes a mix of grounds: the species sheet and the enclosure sheet say so.
textes.Chaque fauteuil d'une salle de projectio: Each seat in a screening room is a place; a screen, a projector and a ticket office are needed (Shows menu, Shift+X).
textes.Chaque habitant mange chaque jour ce qu': Every resident eats each day what they find in nearby shops. Empty shelves: they are hungry, less happy, their health drops, then they move away%s. Admin setting (F10): hunger %s.
textes.Chaque plateau avec une caméra tourne un: Each set with a camera shoots one film at a time; green screen, editing room and workshops serve production (Shows menu, Shift+X).
textes.Chaque pupitre est une place d'élève, ch: Each desk is a pupil place, each board a class and its teacher.
textes.Chaque rang demande des habitants, des h: Each rank requires residents, happy residents and services. It earns the country a bonus and is never lost.
textes.Chaque siège est une place vendue. Le co: Each seat is a ticket sold. Comfort counts in the rating.
textes.Chaque tonne extraite creuse la fosse en: Each tonne extracted digs the pit in benches; the waste rock builds up a spoil heap. The reserve is the rock in the perimeter down to the maximum depth.
textes.Chaque usine, ferme, commerce et entrepô: Every factory, farm, shop and warehouse has its own stock. Trucks deliver to the nearest one that needs it. Warehouses: %s of space in total.
textes.Chaque ville a sa propre caisse. Ce qui: Each town has its own funds. Whatever is built on its territory is paid for by it; whatever is built outside towns is paid for by the country where it is.
Coal and water for the locomotive.
textes.Charpente en treillis, bosses et virages: Lattice wooden frame, hills and tight turns. It creaks, it shakes, that's normal.
textes.Charpente et toit de chaume, pour zèbres: Timber frame and thatched roof, for zebras, giraffes, lions and rhinos (30 places).
textes.Chaudière inclinée, roue dentée sur la c: Tilted boiler, cogwheel on the rack: it pushes its carriages up the slope.
textes.Chauffeurs-livreurs : %d en ville, %d au: Delivery drivers: %d in town, %d working right now, %d free, %d on rounds.
textes.Chauffeurs-livreurs pour toute la ville: Delivery drivers for the whole town
Search for the town of your first village.
textes.Cherche un emploi (allocation %s par moi: Looking for a job (benefit %s per month). Build shops, offices, factories or services.
textes.Chevalement, galeries et bâtiments. Extr: Headframe, tunnels and buildings. Extracts the best ore underground (iron, coal, copper, gold, bauxite); the waste rock piles up in a slag heap next to it.

The town pays the starting grant.

The banker no longer answers the phone.
The splash pool is placed flat.
textes.Le bimoteur qui a lancé l'aviation comme: The twin-engine plane that launched commercial aviation.
The most common twin-jet in the world.

textes.Le city builder où la Terre entière est: The city builder where the whole Earth is your construction site.

The mayor does what they said.

The country pays a grant of %s to %s.

textes.Le premier est champion de la plus haute: The first is champion of the top division
textes.Le premier vol humain, porté par l'air c: The first human flight, carried by hot air.

textes.Le public lance les thèmes, les comédien: The audience throws out the themes, the actors tremble.
The neighbourhood is clean and quiet.
textes.Le rappeur qui a fait danser la boulange: The rapper who got the industrial bakery dancing.

textes.Le squelette du dinosaure m'a regardé de: The dinosaur skeleton gave me a funny look. The children want to come back tomorrow.
textes.Le stade du club a été démoli ! Le club: The club's stadium has been demolished! The club is looking for a new ground (Club menu → Club).
textes.Le taxi collectif de Nairobi, musique à: Nairobi's shared taxi, music at full blast.
textes.Le taxi le plus rapide des villes africa: The fastest taxi in African cities.

textes.Le zoo sous la pluie : les animaux dorme: The zoo in the rain: the animals are asleep, and so are we, almost.

textes.Les automobilistes ont le temps de finir: Drivers have time to finish their newspaper at red lights.

textes.Les changements ne touchent que ce bâtim: Changes only affect this building. They are kept in the save.
textes.Les chantiers avancent au rythme de la v: Construction moves at the pace of life, on weekdays and during the day, just like real sites. Speed up time and wait for the first houses to be lived in: your founders leave the tent as soon as a roof is ready.

textes.Les chantiers ont besoin d'ouvriers (fon: Construction sites need workers (founders, construction companies)

textes.Les chats du quartier n'ont jamais été a: The neighbourhood cats have never been so fat.
textes.Les clients vont ailleurs, ou ne font pa: Customers go elsewhere, or don't do their shopping.
textes.Les commerces sont tout près, c'est prat: The shops are close by, it's handy.
textes.Les deux villages se touchent : n'en fai: The two villages touch: make them a single municipality. The most populated keeps its name and town hall.
textes.Les déchets sont coupés dans les réglage: Waste is turned off in the game settings (Admin, F10): the town stays clean on its own.
textes.Les enfants grandissent vite, et pas tou: Children grow up fast, and not always well-behaved. Build a school linked to the road: without one, your town will never become a Market town.
textes.Les enfants préviennent Guignol. Très fo: The children warn Punch. Very loudly.
textes.Les engins partent dès que la neige tien: The vehicles head out as soon as snow settles (1.5 cm), major roads first, and salt behind them: snow won't settle for 12 h.
textes.Les entreprises cherchent même du monde: Businesses are even looking for people: %s vacant jobs.
textes.Les fermes y apportent leurs récoltes (g: Farms bring their harvests here (grain, rapeseed, hay…): a warehouse for the whole region.
textes.Les files sont longues (%d min en moyenn: Queues are long (%d min on average): add attractions.
textes.Les fondateurs sous la tente attendent d: The founders in tents are waiting for houses.
textes.Les frites sont excellentes. Le prix des: The chips are excellent. The price of the chips, less so.
textes.Les gens s'installent là où il y a du tr: People settle where there are jobs and services: jobs (B, P), schools and shops before new homes.
textes.Les grands squelettes au centre (il faut: The large skeletons in the centre (they need space).
textes.Les habitants font leurs loisirs à la ma: Residents do their hobbies at home.
textes.Les habitants jugent tes décisions sur l: Residents judge your decisions in the Opinions panel (Y). They always have an opinion. Always.
textes.Les habitants ont même cessé de se plain: Residents have even stopped complaining about the weather. That says it all.
textes.Les habitants sont mécontents du nouveau: Residents are unhappy with the new mayor: a petition demands early elections.
textes.Les habitants toussent, et ce n'est pas: Residents are coughing, and it isn't cold season.
textes.Les habitants viennent y faire leurs cou: Residents come here to shop; counters and shelves make the jobs.
textes.Les habitants y vivent : il faut au moin: Residents live here: at least one bed is needed. Each floor with its own kitchen is a flat.
textes.Les habitants y vont entre amis ; le bar: Residents come here with friends; the bar and tables make the jobs.
textes.Les machines du génie de la Renaissance: The machines of the Renaissance genius
textes.Les maisons veulent une route devant la: Houses want a road outside the door: nobody likes walking home across fields in slippers. Draw a road starting from the Village Hall.
textes.Les manifestants ne sont pas écoutés : g: The protesters aren't being listened to: town staff strike tomorrow (%d buildings closed).
textes.Les morceaux (changent avec l'heure : jo: The tracks (change with the time: day, evening, night)
textes.Les obsèques sont désactivées dans les r: Funerals are disabled in the game settings (Admin, F10).
textes.Les options valent pour toutes les parti: Options apply to all games. A game's settings (money, costs, rules) are in the Admin (F10).
textes.Les outils Mur et Pièce montent les murs: The Wall and Room tools raise the walls (and room floors) over this many floors at once, starting from the active floor.
textes.Les ouvriers vont aux chantiers dans l'o: Workers go to sites in the order of the list, each until its crew is complete. Pause or move a site first to balance them.
textes.Les petites rues deviennent piétonnes :: Small streets become pedestrian: only residents, deliveries and emergency vehicles drive there, at walking pace.
textes.Les pionniers de %s ont fini leur missio: The pioneers of %s have finished their mission: the village relies on its own workers (construction company).
textes.Les pompiers prennent la route : une cas: Firefighters take the road: a poorly connected fire station means a fire that has time to settle in.
The bins are overflowing in the street.
textes.Les poubelles qui débordent font baisser: Overflowing bins lower morale. So do bin lorries, but only in the morning.
textes.Les premiers artistes de l'âge de pierre: The first artists of the Stone Age
textes.Les premières automobiles, encore proche: The first automobiles, still close to the carriage.
textes.Les rails suivent le grand côté du recta: The rails follow the long side of the rectangle; wider, several tracks side by side. Workshop decoration: trains run on the network (L key).
textes.Les rangs montent vers l'arrière, dos à: The rows rise towards the back, facing away from the camera (R: rotate). Each seat counts as a visitor of the building.
The shelves are empty at the shop.
textes.Les remettre à la base de chantier du ca: Send them back to the camp's site base
textes.Les rivières montent : risque d'inondati: Rivers are rising: risk of flooding.
textes.Les routes se couvrent de neige : la cir: The roads get covered in snow: traffic slows, the technical centre's snowploughs head out.
textes.Les salles sont trop sombres : ajoute de: The rooms are too dark: add spotlight rails, chandeliers or projectors.

textes.Les sièges pendent sous le rail, les pie: Seats hang under the rail, feet dangling. Inversions allowed.
textes.Les toilettes ? Pas trouvées. On est ren: The toilets? Couldn't find them. We went home early.
textes.Les toilettes ? « Dans l'aile Renaissanc: The toilets? “In the Renaissance wing, at the back on the left, after the Flemish masters.” There aren't any.
textes.Les visiteurs longent les enclos depuis: Visitors walk along the enclosures from the entrance; paths make the visit nicer.

textes.Leurs fiches restent consultables: Their profiles can still be viewed
textes.Ligne de marchandises : trains de fret,: Goods line: freight trains, barges, cargo ships

From “Well-off”, it invests its savings. It also needs a home to match: it moves to a house or a sought-after neighbourhood when it finds a vacant one.

Raised vegetable beds, shed and compost.
textes.Poteaux d'acier et grillage épais, retou: Steel posts and thick mesh, angled at the top. For wolves and lions.

textes.Pour monter, un foyer doit avoir tous le: To move up, a household must have all the needs of the target level (and those below) for a few days, and enough income per person. If it loses a need of its level, it drops back after %d days.

textes.Sans courant : fenêtres noires, usines e: Without power: dark windows, factories and shops slow down. Without water: disease, firefighters without hydrants. After 7 days, households leave. Without heating in winter: cold and disease.
textes.Sans décor de %s, on tourne en extérieur: Without a %s set, filming happens outdoors: 15 %% more expensive and worse.
textes.Sans elles, les visiteurs partent plus t: Without them, visitors leave earlier, and in a bad mood.
textes.Sans elles, les visiteurs écourtent la v: Without them, visitors cut their visit short (and parents get annoyed).
textes.Sans gaz ni chaleur, on se chauffe à l'é: Without gas or heat, people heat with electricity: power demand rises in winter.
textes.Sans l'impôt sur les bénéfices des entre: Excluding corporate tax, paid daily according to sales.
textes.Sans studio d'effets spéciaux, la scienc: Without a special effects studio, science fiction and animation lose a lot.
No steering wheel: it drives itself.
textes.Satisfaction moyenne sur 100 (clic : pan: Average satisfaction out of 100 (click: Opinion panel, Y)
textes.Satisfaction sous %d : la campagne s'ouv: Satisfaction below %d: the campaign opens, vote next Sunday
textes.Satisfaction à %d/100 : l'opposition pré: Satisfaction at %d/100: the opposition is already preparing its posters.
textes.Saute deux mètres de haut. La barrière d: Jumps two metres high. The 1.20 m fence was a bad idea.
textes.Sauvegarde automatique : écrite toutes l: Autosave: written every few minutes (Options > Game), it never overwrites your games.
textes.Sauvegarde impossible, l'atelier attendr: Cannot save, the workshop will wait: %s
textes.Sauvé de justesse il y a cent ans : il e: Saved just in time a hundred years ago: there are more than ten thousand left, and it doesn't look moved.
textes.Savon, lessive, shampoing, papier toilet: Soap, detergent, shampoo, toilet paper and nappies.
textes.Scène, rideaux, fauteuils face à la scèn: Stage, curtains, seats facing the stage, control booth, foyer… in every room of the target building.
Lands on water thanks to its floats.
textes.Sel de déneigement livré au centre techn: De-icing salt delivered to the technical centre: %s t (%s).
textes.Semer le décor choisi au hasard: Scatter the chosen decoration at random
textes.Serres, rangs de légumes et arbres fruit: Greenhouses, rows of vegetables and fruit trees. On good land.
textes.Sert des repas et des boissons (livré en: Serves meals and drinks (supplied with drinks, bread, meat, vegetables…)
textes.Ses chauffeurs-livreurs livrent toute la: Its delivery drivers serve the whole town.
textes.Ses films ressemblent à ses films. Le pu: His films look like his films. The audience likes that.
textes.Seuils de trajet (à pied ou en car) : ma: Travel thresholds (on foot or by bus): nursery and primary 15 min, middle school 25 min, high school 40 min. Beyond double that, the pupil has no school.
textes.Seul un adulte du foyer peut faire démén: Only an adult in the household can move the family.
textes.Seulement s'il y a eu des changements, d: Only if there have been changes, in a separate save (“Autosave”): your own game is never overwritten.
textes.Seules les espèces menacées sont relâché: Only endangered species are released into the wild.
textes.Sinon, les chantiers avancent toujours a: Otherwise, construction sites always progress with a full crew
textes.Six soigneurs : ils nourrissent, nettoie: Six keepers: they feed, clean the enclosures and hand out toys. One keeper looks after about 20 animal places.
textes.Six voix, un DJ, et une énergie de chant: Six voices, a DJ, and construction-site energy.
textes.Skis, luge et piolets anciens: Old skis, sledge and ice axes
textes.Sodas, eau, café et limonade. Indispensa: Sodas, water, coffee and lemonade. Essential after the roller coaster queue.
textes.Soins ralentis : les habitants guérissen: Slower care: residents recover less well.
textes.Sol : clic glissé en rectangle (%s): Floor: click and drag a rectangle (%s)
textes.Soleil, Lune, heure, date et météo: Sun, Moon, time, date and weather
textes.Solide et jolie, mais on ne voit presque: Sturdy and pretty, but you can hardly see through it: plan for windows (glass).
textes.Solitaire, nageur, grimpeur. Une douve n: Solitary, swimmer, climber. A moat won't stop it: it finds it refreshing.
textes.Sondage : clique où forer (%s, résultats: Survey: click where to drill (%s, results in %d days). Right click: cancel.
textes.Sons et musiques fabriqués pour MiniBloc: Sounds and music made for MiniBlocs (tools/build_sons.py), royalty-free (CC0).
textes.Sort de l'école, plein d'idées, aucune h: Fresh out of school, full of ideas, no habits.
textes.Sortie d'égout dans la nature : pas cher: Sewer outlet into the wild: cheap, but it pollutes the river and makes people downstream who drink it sick.
textes.Sortie de route sur le verglas : les sec: Car off the road on black ice: emergency services are on their way.
textes.Souche de cheminée avec son chapeau et s: Chimney stack with its cap and flue.

textes.Squelette de grand dinosaure à long cou: Skeleton of a large long-necked dinosaur
textes.Squelettes de dinosaures, fossiles, miné: Dinosaur skeletons, fossils, minerals, stuffed animals.
textes.Stabulation, salle de traite et tank à l: Cattle shed, milking parlour and milk tank. Cows in the meadows.
textes.Stade au pied des tours: Stadium at the foot of the towers
textes.Statue d'un héros de bande dessinée: Statue of a comic book hero
textes.Statues et bustes sur socles, à tourner: Statues and busts on plinths, to walk around.
textes.Statues, bustes, bronzes et sculptures m: Statues, busts, bronzes and modern sculptures.
textes.Statuette de l'âge de pierre sous cloche: Stone Age figurine under a glass dome
textes.Stock de %s plein : aucun camion ne vien: %s stock full: no truck comes to collect it

textes.Stèles de pierre où l'on dépose de petit: Stone steles where small pebbles are placed, purification house: %d graves.
textes.Subvention de départ au club de sport: Starting grant to the sports club
textes.Sucre filé rose et churros dorés. Les en: Pink candyfloss and golden churros. Children get it everywhere, and so do the bins.
textes.Suivre cet habitant façon Sims : repère: Follow this resident Sims-style: marker above them, camera that follows them, news of their life.
textes.Supprimer cette création de la bibliothè: Delete this creation from the library (copies already placed remain).
textes.Supprimer une station : clic dessus: Delete a station: click on it
textes.Sur la neige, tout le monde roule moins: On snow, everyone drives slower (−8 % per cm, down to −70 %), emergency services included, and cars skid.

textes.Sécheresse : %d jours sans pluie, rivièr: Drought: %d days without rain, rivers and groundwater at %d %%.
textes.Sécheresse : %d jours sans pluie. Les ri: Drought: %d days without rain. Rivers and groundwater are dropping; think about water restrictions (O panel, Water tab).
textes.Sécheresse sévère : les captages et les: Severe drought: water intakes and dams are running slowly.
textes.Sécheresse, alerte renforcée : les champ: Drought, heightened alert: fields are turning yellow, rivers are dropping, risk of brush fires at the edge of woods.
textes.Sécheresse, niveau crise : l'eau est rés: Drought, crisis level: water is reserved for essential uses. Even the mayor had to give up filling their pool.
textes.Sécheresse, vigilance : %d jours sans vr: Drought, watch: %d days without real rain. Out come the watering cans… in moderation.
textes.Sélection trop grande : %d m de côté au: Selection too big: %d m per side at most.
textes.Ta caisse (la ville) touche seulement l': Your funds (the town) only receive the corporate tax on business profits (%d %% × Taxes setting).
textes.Ta cote de popularité ferait pâlir un ch: Your approval rating would make a world champion jealous.
textes.Tab passe en mode Créer : la ville se me: Tab switches to Create mode: the town pauses while you build your dream town hall.
textes.Tableaux aux murs, banquettes au centre,: Paintings on the walls, benches in the centre, spotlights.
Paintings to hang on a solid wall.
textes.Tables de maquillage, portants de costum: Make-up tables, costume racks, a sofa for stage fright.
textes.Tables, bancs, poubelles et ombre. Les f: Tables, benches, bins and shade. Families stay an extra hour.
textes.Tables, guirlandes et petite scène penda: Tables, garlands and a small stage for 8 hours. The neighbours come to party.
textes.Taille de la coupole, de la tour, de la: Size of the dome, tower, vault… (2 to 32 m).
textes.Talus en terrasses où l'on s'assoit dans: Terraced bank where you sit on the grass.
textes.Tapis, trieurs et presses : recyclables: Conveyors, sorters and balers: recyclables in bales (paper, plastic, metal) and glass. Without it, nobody sorts.
textes.Te voilà sur une terre vierge : pas une: Here you are on virgin land: not a road, not a house, not even a "Welcome" sign. First, take a little tour of your property.
textes.Techniciens (révisions et pannes) et age: Technicians (servicing and breakdowns) and cleaners. Without a workshop, a repairer comes from outside, slowly and expensively.
textes.Techniciens qui réparent les barrières u: Technicians who repair worn fences. A worn fence is an escape in the making.
textes.Temps pour arriver par la route, sirène: Time to arrive by road, siren on.
textes.Tempête sur la ville : vent violent et o: Storm over the town: violent wind and thunderstorms!
textes.Tentes des fondateurs et base de chantie: Founders' tents and site base, while the first houses are built.
textes.Terrain cher : parcs, verdure, bord de l: Expensive land: parks, greenery, waterside, services (N → Land value).
textes.Terrain de 105 × 68 m : surfaces de répa: 105 × 68 m pitch: penalty areas, goals and nets.
textes.Terrain multisport en gazon synthétique,: Artificial turf multi-sport court, small goals and fence.
textes.Terrain trop en pente (%d m d'écart, %d: Ground too steep (%d m difference, %d m at most).
textes.Terrain trop pentu : %.0f m de dénivelé: Ground too steep: %.0f m difference in height (maximum %.0f m).
textes.Terrasse au bord de la savane. Le steak: Terrace at the edge of the savannah. The lions opposite think highly of the steak.
textes.Tes bâtiments personnalisés et tes bâtim: Your customized buildings and thin-wall buildings, ready to place again.
textes.Tes promesses (%d sur %d au plus) : elle: Your promises (%d of %d at most): they attract residents bothered by the topic. Kept by the end of the term, they count for the next election; broken, they cost you dearly.
textes.Textes ciselés, salle en larmes au trois: Finely crafted lyrics, the audience in tears by the third song.
textes.Tiens tes promesses de campagne et règle: Keep your campaign promises and fix the most frequent complaints (Y).
textes.Tir de mine à %s : poussière et bruit pe: Blasting at %s: dust and noise for a few seconds.
textes.Tiré par un câble sous la rue, voyageurs: Pulled by a cable under the street, passengers on the running boards.
Pulled on foot by a runner.
textes.Toile rayée, piste de 13 m et gradins. A: Striped canvas, 13 m ring and stands. Acrobats, clowns and jugglers, matinees on Wednesdays and weekends.
textes.Toit en pente douce : moitié basse (0 à: Gently sloping roof: lower half (0 to 50 cm).
textes.Toit en pente douce : moitié haute (50 c: Gently sloping roof: upper half (50 cm to 1 m).
textes.Toit incomplet : %d blocs sur %d (voie,: Roof incomplete: %d blocks out of %d (road, building or insufficient funds).
textes.Toit ou plafond en demi-cylindre (halle,: Half-cylinder roof or ceiling (market hall, station, hangar, nave). Adjustable length.
textes.Toit pointu de tour ronde, avec un léger: Pointed roof for a round tower, with a slight overhang.
textes.Toit posé : %d blocs (Gomme de l'éditeur: Roof placed: %d blocks (block editor Eraser to remove it).
textes.Tombes simples en pleine terre, petites: Simple graves in the ground, small steles facing Mecca, palm trees: %d graves.
textes.Ton conseiller relit les chiffres chaque: Your advisor reviews the figures every day. He's rarely wrong, and he knows it.
textes.Ton personnage naîtra dans la première f: Your character will be born into the first family that settles in town (a couple with a woman aged 18 to 45).
textes.Touches pensées pour un clavier AZERTY (: Keys use physical positions: on QWERTY, WASD moves and Q / E rotates (ZQSD and A / E on AZERTY). Key remapping will come later. Full list in game: F1.
textes.Tour en bois de 6 m avec longues-vues :: 6 m wooden tower with telescopes: enclosures within 60 m are seen better, even behind a wall.
textes.Tournée mondiale, trois semi-remorques d: World tour, three articulated lorries of equipment.
textes.Tournées de 5 h à 12 h, du lundi au same: Rounds from 5 am to noon, Monday to Saturday
textes.Tous les corbillards sont en route: All hearses are on their way
textes.Tous retournent à la base de chantier: Everyone goes back to the site base
It all starts with a Village Hall. Choose a name and a flag, then place it on fairly flat land. No road needed: it's the first stone (and the only one that won't complain about the noise).
Everything is ready: the rank arrives tomorrow.
textes.Tout est prêt. Les habitants attendent l: Everything is ready. The residents are waiting for their roads.
textes.Tout va bien : les bennes passent et les: All is well: the lorries come by and the waste is treated.
textes.Tout va bien. Les visiteurs crient sur l: All is well. Visitors are screaming on the rides, that's a good sign.
textes.Tout va bien. Une espèce menacée de plus: All is well. One more endangered species would draw a crowd.
textes.Toutes les décharges sont pleines : reco: All landfills are full: cap them and build another one, or an incinerator.
textes.Toutes les lignes : %s de recettes, %s d: All lines: %s revenue, %s expenses, result %s per month.
textes.Toutes les parties sauvegardées, avec le: All saved games, with their preview

textes.Toutes les villes reliées par la route (: All towns connected by road (at least two).
textes.Toutes les villes à 70 de satisfaction (: All towns at 70 satisfaction (at least 200 residents).

textes.Transformateur grillé : %d bâtiment%s da: Transformer burnt out: %d building%s in the dark.
textes.Transformer un carrefour en giratoire (a: Turn a junction into a roundabout (also: Shift + click)
textes.Transports (lignes, trafic, circulation,: Transport (lines, traffic, circulation, vehicles), Town (residents, emergencies, opinions, budget, waste), Economy (production, agriculture), Leisure (create a park, park panel, museum, zoo), Info (news, maps): one click opens their row of panels; the keys stay the same
textes.Travailler, dormir, recommencer : tes ha: Work, sleep, repeat: your residents deserve better. Place a garden square, a plaza, a playground or a sports ground near the houses. Happy people vote better (so they say).
textes.Trente ans de refrains, quatre chanteurs: Thirty years of choruses, four singers, an audience that sings louder.
textes.Trente centimètres d'eau, des champignon: Thirty centimetres of water, sprinkling mushrooms and a giant tipping bucket. Parents stay dry (in theory).
textes.Trente voix, des claquements de mains et: Thirty voices, hand claps and the audience on its feet for the encore.
textes.Trente-deux fouettés et des tutus blancs: Thirty-two fouettés and white tutus as far as the eye can see.
textes.Trois caisses de diligence posées sur un: Three stagecoach bodies on one chassis.
textes.Trois chèvres et un âne. On a vite fait: Three goats and a donkey. We were done in no time.
textes.Trois distributeurs, aucun vendeur. Ils: Three machines, no seller. They give change when they feel like it.
Three garage doors and a tower.
textes.Trois portes qui claquent, deux amants d: Three slamming doors, two lovers in the wardrobe.
Three wheels, a roof, no doors.
textes.Trois vases et une affiche. J'ai les mêm: Three vases and a poster. My grandmother has the same ones.
textes.Troncs flottants dans un canal, un tapis: Logs floating in a channel, a lift belt and a drop that soaks the front row.
Too far from %s (%.1f km at most).
textes.Trop loin des installations (au plus %d: Too far from the facilities (at most %d m).

textes.Très demandé en décembre. Le reste de l': In high demand in December. The rest of the year, it grazes while waiting.
textes.Tu as perdu la mairie. Tu peux continuer: You lost the town hall. You can carry on in sandbox, or return to the globe for a new game.
textes.Tu deviens maire de %s à %d habitants (a: You become mayor of %s at %d residents (today: %d). The first term starts then.
textes.Tu en es le président : effectif, tactiq: You are its chairman: squad, tactics, transfers, ticketing, youth academy. The club starts in %s with local players and can climb up to %s. It has its own funds; the town gives %s at the start and earns the venue rent at every game.

You are its chairman: squad, tactics, transfers, ticketing. The club starts in the Regional league with local players, and can climb up to the Premier League. It has its own funds; the town pays %s at the start and receives the stadium rent at each match.
textes.Tu es %s. ZQSD pour marcher, V pour reve: You are %s. WASD to walk, V to return to the top view.
textes.Tu es dans l'atelier : « Quitter » (7) r: You are in the workshop: "Quit" (7) takes you back to the game.

textes.Tu n'es plus maire de %s : c'est %s qui: You are no longer mayor of %s: %s draws its districts.
textes.Tu n'es plus maire de %s : le conseil de: You are no longer mayor of %s: the “%s” council decides taxes, loans and upkeep.
You are no longer mayor of %s: the “%s” council decides taxes, loans and upkeep. Win back the town hall at the next local elections (Y).
textes.Tu n'es plus maire de %s : ses quartiers: You are no longer mayor of %s: its districts remain.
textes.Tu n'es plus maire de %s : son conseil r: You are no longer mayor of %s: its council refuses to pay money back to the country.

textes.Tutoriel guidé (conseillé pour une premi: Guided tutorial (recommended for a first game)
