textes.Téléphone fixe et ADSL par le cuivre, le: Landline and ADSL over copper, along roads (up to 5 km), and fibre origin (5,000 lines).
textes.Téléphones, ordinateurs, téléviseurs, la: Phones, computers, TVs, washing machines, tools.
textes.Têtu ? Prudent. Il refuse ce qu'il trouv: Stubborn? Cautious. It refuses what it finds dangerous, and it finds a lot of things dangerous.
textes.Un arbre est tombé sur la route : elle e: A tree has fallen on the road: it is blocked.
textes.Un battant par mètre de mur : pose-la su: One leaf per metre of wall: place it on 2 m for a double door.
A building is on the perimeter.
A building is on the site.
A building is in the way.
A baby doesn't go anywhere alone.
textes.Un café du musée retient les visiteurs (: A museum café keeps visitors (and their money).
textes.Un centre de formation est bâti en ville: A training centre has been built in town: youngsters improve faster there.
textes.Un clic = un élément de la forme choisie: One click = one piece of the chosen shape, against the ground or another block. R: rotate.
textes.Un clic pose le toit sur le dernier étag: One click places the roof on the top floor of the targeted building (chosen roof material, otherwise the model's).
textes.Un commissariat qui couvre le quartier (: A police station covering the neighbourhood (B → Public services).
textes.Un couloir, deux salles de classe avec p: A corridor, two classrooms with desks and board, toilets.
textes.Un couple se dispute pendant deux heures: A couple argue for two hours about the cat's name.
textes.Un court central en terre battue avec tr: A clay centre court with stands, four hard courts and a clubhouse. Team league (Sports club).
textes.Un disque de couleur au-dessus de chaque: A coloured disc above each home: red unhappy, yellow average, green happy.
textes.Un décor au centre, caméras, grue, trave: A set in the centre, cameras, crane, dolly, spotlights, boom and director's chair.
textes.Un détecteur par logement et par commerc: One detector per home and per shop, the town helps buy them.
An enclosure has at least 3 corners.
textes.Un enfant a crié « C'est moche ! » devan: A child shouted “That's ugly!” in front of the modern art. He wasn't entirely wrong.
textes.Un fossé invisible depuis les allées : l: A ditch invisible from the paths: the view is perfect. But anything that swims gets across.
textes.Un foyer de marbre, une salle de plus de: A marble foyer, a hall of over 300 seats, the orchestra pit in front of a 7 m stage: opera, ballet and musicals.
textes.Un foyer et son bar, une grande fosse de: A foyer and its bar, a large 700-place standing pit in front of a rock stage (drums, amps, speaker stacks), the control booth at the back, dressing rooms.
textes.Un foyer, plus de 200 fauteuils face à u: A foyer, over 200 seats facing a large stage where the orchestra sits before its conductor, piano and harp included.
textes.Un foyer, une salle de 70 fauteuils de v: A foyer, a hall of 70 velvet seats in front of a red-curtained stage, a control booth and a dressing room.
textes.Un galion qui se balance jusqu'à la vert: A galleon that swings up to vertical. The back row screams loudest.
textes.Un grand bateau, une longue montée et un: A big boat, a long climb and a single drop. The wave also soaks the spectators' bridge.
textes.Un grand foyer avec son bar et son lustr: A large foyer with its bar and chandelier, a 400-seat hall, a 6 m stage, dressing rooms, the costume workshop and the set workshop.
textes.Un grand hall (billetterie, bornes, conf: A large hall (box office, kiosks, confectionery), three screening rooms of 70 to 110 seats.
textes.Un géant gonflé qui traversait l'Atlanti: An inflated giant that crossed the Atlantic.
textes.Un hall avec billetterie, confiserie et: A hall with box office, confectionery and popcorn, a hall of a hundred red seats in front of a panoramic screen.
textes.Un hall avec sa billetterie, une salle d: A hall with its ticket office, a history room, a small shop and toilets.
textes.Un hangar de 14 m sous plafond, noir et: A 14 m high hangar, dark and silent: one more film shooting at a time.
textes.Un hôpital à moins de 30 min, avec des l: A hospital less than 30 min away, with free beds (B → Public services).
textes.Un immeuble, une cour, cinq fenêtres et: A building, a courtyard, five windows and as many lives.
textes.Un impôt national élevé remplit la caiss: A high national tax fills the country's funds but empties the towns'. The grant helps small towns grow. Customs earn money for the country, but make what its businesses buy across the border more expensive.
textes.Un jeune du centre de formation, %s, rej: A youngster from the academy, %s, joins the team.
textes.Un lac ou une rivière est dans le périmè: A lake or river is inside the perimeter.
textes.Un magasin d'électronique et un magasin: A stocked electronics store and furniture store.
textes.Un nez qui pousse vraiment, à chaque men: A nose that really grows, with every lie.
textes.Un nez, un panache, et le balcon le plus: A nose, panache, and the most famous balcony in theatre.
textes.Un parc : pelouses, bosquets, étang et h: A park: lawns, groves, pond and low hedges; %d graves and a garden of remembrance.
textes.Un parking ne se dessert pas par une lig: A car park isn't served by a line.
textes.Un piano à queue, une pianiste, deux rap: A grand piano, a pianist, two encores.
textes.Un pressoir, un alambic, des tonneaux, u: A wine press, a still, barrels, an old stove and a fine wine cellar, a hall and a shop.
textes.Un prince, un oiseleur, une Reine de la: A prince, a bird-catcher, a very high-pitched Queen of the Night.
textes.Un repas de famille qui tourne à l'inven: A family meal that turns into an inventory.
textes.Un restaurant ou une buvette (onglet Vis: A restaurant or a refreshment stand (Visitors tab).
textes.Un seul thème, un crescendo de dix-sept: A single theme, a seventeen-minute crescendo.
textes.Un seul véhicule diesel pour les petites: A single diesel vehicle for small lines.
textes.Un toboggan ne se boucle pas : termine-l: A slide doesn't loop: finish it with a splash pool.
textes.Un village commence par une Maison de co: A village starts with a Village Hall and 1 M€. The rest is paperwork.
textes.Un visiteur a touché une œuvre. Le gardi: A visitor touched a work. The attendant jumped two metres.
textes.Un zoo commence par son entrée, posée au: A zoo starts with its entrance, placed beside a road. Enclosures and buildings within 400 m are part of it.
textes.Un échangeur se pose en un clic sur une: An interchange is placed in one click on a road crossing over a motorway. The traffic jams come on their own.
Another pit or spoil heap is there.
textes.Une benne rentre pleine : aucune usine p: A bin lorry comes back full: no plant for its waste.
textes.Une bosse : dromadaire. Deux bosses : ch: One hump: dromedary. Two humps: camel. None: it's out of the enclosure.
textes.Une bosse de 14 m, des virages relevés,: A 14 m hill, banked turns, a five-car train. The queen of the park.
textes.Une boulangerie, une supérette ou un mar: A stocked bakery, mini-market or market nearby (P → shops).
textes.Une boutique de vêtements, une pharmacie: A stocked clothes shop, pharmacy or supermarket.
textes.Une boutique rapporte : caisse et présen: A shop pays off: till and souvenir displays.
textes.Une caisse à l'avant pour les enfants ou: A box at the front for children or shopping.
textes.Une carte de couleur sur le terrain auto: A colour map on the terrain around the camera. Hover over a tile to read its values.
textes.Une centaine de courageux plantent leurs: About a hundred brave souls pitch their tents near the town hall. They are the workers for your first construction sites, then your first residents once they have a roof. Supplies won't last forever: take a look at their camp.
textes.Une clinique vétérinaire soignerait vite: A veterinary clinic would quickly treat sick animals.
textes.Une comédie musicale sur l'éclairage pub: A musical about street lighting. Yes. And it's a triumph.
textes.Une concession agricole en ville fait ba: A farm dealership in town lowers prices.
textes.Une déchèterie fait mieux trier les habi: A recycling centre makes residents within 4 km sort better.
textes.Une exposition attire les touristes et l: An exhibition draws tourists and residents for a few weeks. It works best in a “Temporary exhibition room” (otherwise, half the effect).
textes.Une file d'attente commence devant l'ent: A queue line starts in front of the entrance of an attraction or park stall.
textes.Une fosse ou une verse d'extraction occu: An extraction pit or spoil heap occupies the site.
textes.Une grande galerie des dinosaures sous v: A grand dinosaur gallery under a glass roof, a natural history room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une grande halle des machines, une salle: A large machine hall, a history of technology room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une grande halle du chemin de fer avec s: A large railway hall with its locomotive, cars, air and space, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une grande salle du sport (maillots, cou: A large sports room (jerseys, cups, medals, bikes), an exhibition room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une grande scène, la fosse d'orchestre d: A large stage, the orchestra pit in front, then the seats.
textes.Une grotte peinte, une hutte en os de ma: A painted cave, a mammoth-bone hut, flints and skulls, a natural history room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une hausse d'impôts, une coupure ou une: A tax rise, an outage or a closure? Residents' opinion (Y) gives the reasons.
A line links at least two stations.
textes.Une ligne relie des stations du même gen: A line links stations of the same kind (%s).
textes.Une maison ou un logement confortable da: A house or comfortable home in a sought-after neighbourhood.
textes.Une maison sans eau ni électricité, c'es: A house without water or electricity is camping (and your founders have had enough). Place a power source (national grid connection, wind turbine, solar…) and a water source (borehole, or intake near a river) near a road. Good news: the country's first town receives the State setup kit, and its vouchers pay for these buildings (details: Shift+P). Roads already carry small cables and pipes.
textes.Une maison, un logement confortable ou u: A house, a comfortable home or a sought-after neighbourhood.
textes.Une momie à côté d'une machine à vapeur: A mummy next to a steam engine: I didn't quite get the visitor route.
textes.Une partie commence par la fondation d'u: A game starts with the founding of a village. Choose its name, then place its Village Hall anywhere on the map: no road needed, it's the first stone.
textes.Une partie du tracé passe sous la gare :: Part of the layout passes under the station: check it doesn't go into the ground (otherwise it's a tunnel).
textes.Une petite scène (batterie, piano, contr: A small stage (drums, piano, double bass), cabaret tables, the bar.
textes.Une petite scène, des tables de cabaret: A small stage, cabaret tables and the bar.
textes.Une petite scène, un bar et des humorist: A small stage, a bar and comedians starting out. The front row is in danger.
textes.Une plage en pente douce et une vague to: A gently sloping beach and a wave every ten seconds. The lifeguards blow their whistles, it's their job.
A giant wheel at the front.
textes.Une route ou un chemin passe sur ce cham: A road or path crosses this field.
textes.Une route qui ne mène nulle part reste u: A road that leads nowhere is still a road. Residents, however, prefer it to lead somewhere.
textes.Une salle avec son bar et ses tables, un: A room with its bar and tables, a kitchen and toilets.
textes.Une salle de cinéma avec ses fauteuils r: A cinema with its red seats, a music room, a fashion gallery, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une salle de la marine (galion, scaphand: A maritime room (galleon, diving suit, lighthouse, lifeboat, aquarium), a natural history room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une salle de post-production raccourcit: A post-production room shortens editing and improves the film.
textes.Une salle de vente derrière ses vitrines: A sales floor behind its shop windows, a storeroom and toilets.
textes.Une salle des jouets (maison de poupée,: A toy room (doll's house, trains, arcade), a comics room, a hall, a shop, a café.
textes.Une sauvegarde automatique est faite tou: An autosave is made every 5 minutes if there have been changes (Options > Game).
textes.Une scène et ses instruments, une fosse: A stage and its instruments, a standing pit (2 people per free m²) or seats, a ticket office (Shows menu, Shift+X).
textes.Une scène, des fauteuils face à elle et: A stage, seats facing it and a ticket office; an orchestra pit opens up opera and ballet (Shows menu, Shift+X).
textes.Une seule collection : d'autres thèmes a: Only one collection: other themes will draw other visitors.
textes.Une station météo (Construire → Services: A weather station (Build → Public services) gives 7 days.
textes.Une tour, un tube qui serpente et un bas: A tower, a winding tube and a splash pool. Open course: you walk back up.
textes.Une usine de recyclage transforme les ba: A recycling plant turns the sorting centre's bales into paper, plastic and steel.
A town becomes a Small town.
textes.Une visite magnifique. J'ai même lu les: A magnificent visit. I even read the labels, that says it all.
textes.Une voie est réservée aux bus : ils évit: One lane is reserved for buses: they avoid traffic jams, cars have one lane less.
textes.Une voie navigable doit rester sur l'eau: A navigable waterway must stay on water.
textes.Une voie ou une station passe sur l'empl: A way or a station crosses the site.
A road or track runs here.
A road or track crosses the site.
A road or track crosses the perimeter.
textes.Une voix grave, un piano, et la salle qu: A deep voice, a piano, and an audience holding its breath.
textes.Une zone est peinte sur ce carré : retir: A zone is painted on this square: remove it first.
textes.Une école avec des places, assez proche: A school with places, close enough (B → Public services).
textes.Une étape à la fois en haut à gauche : f: One step at a time at the top left: found the village, draw a road, zone, power and water… Can be turned off at any time (F10 → Help).
textes.Urgence · en intervention, sirène hurlan: Emergency · on a call, siren wailing
textes.Usure coupée dans l'Admin (F10) : les vo: Wear turned off in the Admin (F10): roads stay new.
textes.Utilise des outils, ouvre les cadenas et: Uses tools, opens padlocks and laughs at the keepers. A high, covered fence is recommended.
textes.V : vue au sol (3e puis 1re personne) ·: V: ground view (3rd then 1st person) · WASD: walk · mouse: look around
textes.V passe en vue au sol. Admire ton œuvre: V switches to ground view. Admire your work up close, and the potholes too.
textes.Vase bleu et blanc sur socle: Blue and white vase on a plinth
textes.Vend, loue et répare les tracteurs et le: Sells, rents and repairs tractors and machines: purchases 10 % cheaper, repairs half price.
textes.Vendre %s de marchandises entre tes vill: Sell %s of goods between your towns
textes.Vendu en début de saison. Les abonnés pa: Sold at the start of the season. Holders pay in advance and come to every home game.
textes.Verre feuilleté de 4 cm. Les enfants y c: 4 cm laminated glass. Children press their noses to it, tigers too.
textes.Verrière métallique à petits carreaux, s: Small-paned metal glass roof, several metres wide (loft, factory).
textes.Verrière à 28 °C et 80 % d'humidité : cr: Glass roof at 28 °C and 80 % humidity: crocodiles, tortoises, orangutans spend the winter there (30 places).
textes.Verrière à petits carreaux et fins monta: Glass roof with small panes and thin mullions (loft, factory).
textes.Vert : chauffé par le réseau · orange :: Green: heated by the network · orange: partly · red: electric heating or cold
textes.Vert : desservi · orange : rationné · ro: Green: served · orange: rationed · red: cut off
textes.Vide pour l'instant : le bouton Enregist: Empty for now: the editor's Save button stores a layout here.
textes.Vieillissement, naissances et décès. Les: Ageing, births and deaths. Schedules always follow the game clock.
textes.Vient de l'Himalaya. Notre été lui sembl: Comes from the Himalayas. Our summer seems like a settings error to it.
textes.Vigilance crues %s : %s mm de pluie en t: Flood watch %s: %s mm of rain in three days, rivers are rising.
textes.Village « %s » fondé ! Son territoire :: Village “%s” founded! Its territory: %d ha around the town hall. It will grow with the population.
textes.Ville sous tutelle du préfet : aucun nou: Town under the prefect's supervision: no new loans.
textes.Ville sous tutelle du préfet : impôts re: Town under the prefect's supervision: taxes raised to %d %%, no more loans or public buildings. It leaves after %d days without debt in the funds (%d/%d).
textes.Ville sous tutelle du préfet : pas de no: Town under the prefect's supervision: no new public buildings.
textes.Ville, nature, oiseaux, grillons, pluie,: Town, nature, birds, crickets, rain, wind, sea, traffic, construction: depending on what the camera sees
textes.Violon de maître luthier sous cloche: Master luthier's violin under a glass dome
textes.Virage impossible dans une pente de plus: Turn impossible on a slope steeper than 25°.
textes.Virage trop serré : rayon %d m (minimum: Bend too tight: radius %d m (minimum %d m for %s at %d km/h).
textes.Vise d'abord un bâtiment avec un outil M: First target a building with a Walls and floors tool.
textes.Vise d'abord un bâtiment en murs fins (s: First target a thin-wall building (hover over it with a tool from this tab).
First target a thin-wall building (hover over it with a placement tool, or click it with the Function tool).
textes.Vise un bâtiment en murs fins (onglet Éd: Target a thin-wall building (Free editor tab, Walls and floors) or place a furnished building.
textes.Visite fatigante : bancs, cartels, panne: Tiring visit: benches, labels, signs and maps make the visit more pleasant.
textes.Vitesse : %s. T met en pause, Maj + T ch: Speed: %s. T pauses, Shift + T changes the speed.
textes.Vitesse des chantiers (bâtiments, voies,: Speed of construction sites (buildings, roads, networks) compared to real durations
textes.Vitesse limitée à 30 km/h dans les rues: Speed limited to 30 km/h in the district's streets and avenues, speed bumps and signs.
textes.Vitrine de boutique avec son store rayé: Shop window with its striped awning on the street side.
textes.Vitrine de consoles de jeux vidéo: Display case of video game consoles
textes.Vitrine de minéraux et cristaux: Display case of minerals and crystals
textes.Vitrine de montres et de mouvements: Display case of watches and movements
textes.Vivres : encore %d jours pour %d personn: Food: %d days left for %d people in tents.
textes.Vivres apportés par les fondateurs ; ens: Food brought by the founders; after that, the camp's supplies are paid from the town funds
textes.Vivres épuisés : le ravitaillement du ca: Food exhausted: supplying the camp costs %s per day (%d founders in tents).
textes.Vivres épuisés : ravitaillement payé par: Food exhausted: supplies paid from the funds, %s per day.
textes.Voie de 60 cm : petit train de parc, de: 60 cm gauge: little park, mine or garden train.
textes.Voie de montagne ou de tramway ancien, 1: Mountain or old tramway track, 1 m gauge.
textes.Voie normale de 1,435 m sur ballast et t: 1.435 m standard gauge on ballast and wooden sleepers. Wider: several tracks side by side (4.50 m apart).
textes.Voie normale sur traverses en béton, ent: Standard gauge on concrete sleepers, 4.80 m apart.
textes.Voile carrée, boucliers et tête de drago: Square sail, shields and a dragon's head.
Battened sails and a high stern.
textes.Voir le bâtiment et y aller: View the building and go there
textes.Voir les territoires sur la carte (aussi: Show territories on the map (also in N)
textes.Voitures de course, limousines, citadine: Racing cars, limousines, city cars, engines, petrol pumps.
textes.Voitures en cale, passagers sur les pont: Cars in the hold, passengers on the decks.
textes.Voitures sur plateaux tournants, moteurs: Cars on turntables, engines, pumps and enamel signs.
Midnight-blue sleeping cars with gold lines.
textes.Volume rond plein : silo, château d'eau,: Solid round volume: silo, water tower, rotunda, giant column.
textes.Vue par étage : aucun bâtiment à étages: Floor view: no thin-wall multi-storey building around here. “Open the interior” (Customize) creates one from the catalogue.
textes.Vue sous terre : %d m, c'est le plus pro: Underground view: %d m is the deepest level.
textes.Vue sous terre : Page bas pour descendre: Underground view: Page Down to go deeper, Page Up to go back up, Home or Esc to return to the surface.
textes.Vue sous terre : seulement depuis la vue: Underground view: only from the top view.
textes.Véhicule de secours et d'assistance aux: Rescue and victim assistance vehicle, red with yellow stripes.
Clothes and shoes in the window.
textes.Wagonnets dans le noir, squelettes et to: Cars in the dark, skeletons and cobwebs. The ghost on the roof is a former accountant.
textes.Wagonnets, tunnels et virages au ras des: Cars, tunnels and turns skimming the rocks. The family roller coaster.
textes.ZQSD / flèches : déplacer · Molette: WASD / arrows: move   ·   Wheel: zoom   ·   Q / E or middle click: rotate   ·   Right click and drag: move the map
textes.ZQSD marcher · Maj courir · Espace saute: WASD walk · Shift run · Space jump · Mouse look · Wheel camera · V change view · E get into a nearby vehicle · Esc release the mouse
textes.ZQSD ou flèches : se déplacer · molette: WASD or arrows: move · wheel: zoom · Q / E: rotate
textes.Zonage hors du territoire de tes village: Zoning outside your villages' territory: expand it first (Shift+M).
textes.Zone %s : clic gauche glissé pour peindr: %s zone: left click and drag to paint a rectangle (%s per m²) · right click or Esc: stop
textes.Zone trop grande : %d m de côté au maxim: Zone too big: %d m per side at most.
textes.Zones : R %d m² · C %d m² · I %d m²: Zones: R %d m²  ·  C %d m²  ·  I %d m²
textes.Zoo : clic dans un enclos pour voir ses: Zoo: click in an enclosure to see its animals and their needs.
textes.achetés à la création de la ligne (prix: bought when the line is created (real price depending on the model, Admin cost setting), resold according to their age; they age, cost more upkeep and break down after their lifespan (bus 12 years, tram 30, train 35…): “Renew worn ones” or Automatic box
textes.afficher la circulation, choisir l'époqu: show traffic, choose the era and region of vehicles, change view
textes.afficher ou masquer le panneau Construir: show or hide the Build panel (categories as icons, buildings as thumbnails)
textes.agriculteurs aux champs, bûcherons, carr: farmers in the fields, lumberjacks, quarry workers, fishers, merchants, police on duty, firefighters near their truck
textes.air et eau pollués (%), bruit (dB, jour: polluted air and water (%), noise (dB, day and night) and land price (€/m²) in the terrain profile
textes.aller à des coordonnées ou à un lieu con: go to coordinates or a known place, technical info (tiles, tide)
textes.allées pavées, en bois, en terre ou en a: paved, wooden, dirt or asphalt paths, drawn by hand; a queue starts at an attraction's entrance and visitors follow it
textes.annuler (éditeur libre : blocs, murs et: undo (free editor: blocks, walls and floors)
textes.aplanir, monter de 1 m, creuser de 1 m (: level, raise by 1 m, dig by 1 m (left click and drag)
textes.bancs et poteaux le long des routes, pon: benches and posts along roads, jetties and boats near your buildings, rocks and wild ducks; elsewhere the Earth stays untouched (checkbox in the panel)
textes.barrière trop basse (%.1f m, il faut %.1: fence too low (%.1f m, %.1f m needed)
textes.barrière trop basse ou usée : évasions ;: fence too low or worn: escapes; big cats and prey together: predation; dirty enclosure or poorly cared-for animals: diseases. Births when well-being is good
textes.basket (samedi soir, pas de nul, prolong: basketball (Saturday night, no draws, overtime), handball (Friday night), hockey (September to March, shootouts), rugby (Sunday, bonus points), team tennis (group of 8 in spring, 4 singles and 2 doubles)
textes.billets (prix au choix : trop cher, les: tickets (price of your choice: too expensive and the stands empty), refreshment stand, shop, sponsors, TV rights, league bonuses, player sales; against wages, staff, transfers and the stadium rent paid to the town
textes.billets et bar contre cachet, technique,: tickets and bar against fee, technical costs, royalties (9 %) and wages; at the cinema, half the ticket goes to the distributor, or to your studios if it's your film
textes.bouton du menu principal : une partie d': main menu button: a game of about 30 minutes near Échallens, the tutorial then six chapters (ground view, leisure, party, bus, 100 residents) and a summary; the game continues afterwards
textes.bouton du panneau (ou panneau Cartes) :: panel button (or Maps panel): each home in colour, green well covered, yellow far, orange saturated, red nothing; services in blue
textes.bouton du panneau : routes colorées du v: panel button: roads coloured from green (flowing) to red (jammed), now or at rush hour; car parks coloured by occupancy
textes.bouton du panneau : un appel au hasard p: panel button: a random call near the camera, to watch the emergency services set off
textes.bouton « Recouvrir » du panneau : elle d: panel “Cap” button: it becomes a green hill and pollutes much less
textes.budget courant par réseau, réparation au: routine budget per network, automatic repair below a threshold, condition map (green → red), “View” and “Repair” on the worst sections; wear speed in the Admin (F10)
textes.bâtiment trop grand pour être ouvert (%d: building too big to be opened (%d m per side at most)
textes.bâtiments et voies se construisent étape: buildings and roads are built step by step at the pace of life (house ≈ 3 game weeks), on weekdays and in daytime; the price is paid as work progresses; Admin panel (F10): crew hours or instant construction
textes.bâtiments et zonage seulement sur le ter: buildings and zoning only on the territory; roads, networks and lines everywhere; Admin (F10) → Construction to turn these rules off
textes.caisse dans le rouge 90 jours : le préfe: funds in the red for 90 days: the prefect raises taxes to 150 %, blocks loans and public buildings until 30 days without debt
textes.caisse, habitants, satisfaction, chômage: funds, residents, satisfaction, unemployment: one click opens the Residents panel (satisfaction: the Opinions panel)
textes.caméra extérieure (souris pour tourner a: outside camera (mouse to orbit, wheel to zoom out) or driver's seat
textes.canicule (30 °C) : clim et soif font gri: heatwave (30 °C): air conditioning and thirst push up demand; drought (more than 12 days without rain): rivers and groundwater drop; Water tab: water restrictions (−20 %)
textes.carrefour : clic pour changer son régime: junction: click to change its control (auto, lights, stop, give way, priority to the right)
textes.carrés de 100 × 100 m autour de la mairi: 100 × 100 m squares around the town hall: 500 m at the start, it grows on its own with the population (800 m at 100 inh., 1.2 km at 500, 2 km at 2,000, 3 km at 10,000)
textes.case sous la courbe : une couleur par vi: box under the curve: one colour per town
textes.case sur le globe (cochée par défaut) :: box on the globe (ticked by default): one step at a time at the top left (camera, found the village, founders, road, housing, power and water, time, jobs, school, budget, objectives); each step validates itself once you've done it
textes.caserne de pompiers (FPT, VSAV, grande é: fire station (fire engine, ambulance, turntable ladder), police station (police, or gendarmerie in a town of fewer than 2,000 residents), hospital (ambulances, mobile ICU)
textes.ce bâtiment ne s'ouvre pas encore (seule: this building can't be opened yet (only houses, apartment blocks, shops, restaurants, offices, workshops, schools)
textes.ce modèle vient d'une version du jeu qui: this model comes from a version of the game that doesn't have this building
textes.ce que disent quelques habitants, les pl: what a few residents say, the unhappiest first (click: their profile)
textes.ce qui empêche de dormir : grandes route: what keeps people awake: major roads, rail, airports, bars and nightclubs.
textes.ce qui se construit sur le territoire d': whatever is built on a town's territory is paid from its funds; roads and buildings outside towns, by the country; business sales are shared according to population
textes.centrale biomasse ou au charbon, raccord: biomass or coal power plant, national grid connection, wind turbines, solar
textes.centrales (charbon, gaz, bois, nucléaire: power plants (coal, gas, wood, nuclear, dam, wind turbine, solar, national grid that can be placed anywhere), batteries (store the surplus for the night and windless days), water intake and borehole, water tower, treatment plant, lagoon treatment, direct discharge
textes.chaque bus, tram ou métro a ses places ;: each bus, tram or metro has its seats; when full, people wait for the next one; ticket price adjustable per line (1.50 € by default, free for under-18s)
textes.chaque logement, commerce et entreprise: every home, shop and business fills its bins (1.4 kg per resident per day); when full, it overflows: bags on the pavement, unhappy residents, dirty street
textes.chaque route porte la desserte locale :: each road carries the local supply: a building less than 30 m from a road connected to a source is served
textes.chaque rue a une capacité (voies × débit: each street has a capacity (lanes × flow of its class); the busier it is at rush hour, the slower traffic moves, and residents change route or take the bus or bike
textes.chaque site a son stock ; des camions co: each site has its stock; trucks driven by delivery drivers (Monday-Friday) deliver to the nearest one that needs it. Without a driver or road: empty shelves and unhappy residents. Warehouses act as relays; the rest comes by import (road leaving the map, depot, station, port)
textes.chaque ville a ses impôts, ses emprunts,: each town has its taxes, loans, upkeep and supervision; the funds shown at the top are those of the town the camera is looking at (Manage in Shift+P to pin it)
textes.chaque ville appartient au pays réel où: each town belongs to the real country it is in; each of your countries has its funds, national tax, grant and customs (Shift+P, country buttons); a new country receives a setup grant and pays the capital of its first town
textes.chaque ville vote de son côté, pour son: each town votes on its own, for its mayor; the Opinions panel (Y) shows the managed town
textes.chemins depuis l'entrée, vue sur les enc: paths from the entrance, view of the enclosures (glass and moats are best), rare and endangered species: rating, prestige and conservation donations
textes.chiffre du jour et évolution sur 30 jour: figure for the day and change over 30 days (green: improving, red: getting worse); click a line to plot its curve, hover over the curve to read a date
textes.choisis un type, pose la gare (R tourne): choose a type, place the station (R rotates), then add pieces one by one: straights, turns, slopes, loops, corkscrews, brakes, launcher… Lift chain for climbs; Close loop links the end to the station; Backspace removes the last piece
textes.clic : un décor ; glisser : une rangée,: click: one decoration; drag: a row, or a fence from one point to another; R / Shift+R: rotate
textes.clic de départ, clic de direction, clic: start click, direction click, end click
textes.clic ou glisser sur la carte : îlots de: click or drag on the map: 50 × 50 m blocks, brush from 1 to 9 × 9 blocks; Eraser to remove; right click or Esc to stop; a district stays inside its town's territory
textes.clic pour chaque point, clic droit ou Éc: click for each point, right click or Esc to finish; the section has its construction site before going into service
textes.clic pour commencer, clic pour chaque po: click to start, click for each point
textes.clic sur un carré qui touche le territoi: click a square touching the territory to buy it, or an empty square to give it back; right click or Esc to stop
textes.clic sur un terrain plat, R : tourner: click on flat land, R: rotate
textes.clic sur un tronçon pour l'enlever (30 %: click a section to remove it (30 % refunded)
textes.clic sur une nouvelle pour aller sur pla: click a news item to go there
textes.clic sur une route : la fibre (1 Gb/s) s: click a road: fibre (1 Gb/s) follows the whole street; it must touch an exchange or an optical node
textes.clic sur une route qui enjambe une autor: click a road that crosses over a motorway: 4 slip roads
textes.clic à chaque coin, clic sur le premier: click at each corner, click the first point or Enter to close, drag for a rectangle, Backspace erases the last corner; 9 barriers (wood, electric, mesh, fence, reinforced, aviary, glass, wall, moat): height, strength, view and price
textes.commerces plus attirants, terrains plus: more attractive shops, more expensive land

textes.Chaudière en cuivre et cheminée : la pom: Copper boiler and chimney: the pump works on its own, pulled at a gallop by two horses.
textes.Banquettes à l'air libre, échelle en boi: Open benches, a wooden ladder and a brass bell.
The pump tender and its two-tone siren.
textes.La voiture suspendue des « ambulances vo: The sprung carriage of the “flying ambulances”: two stretchers and a surgeon.
textes.Carrosserie bombée et croix rouge sur le: Rounded bodywork and a red cross on the sides.
textes.Le break surélevé, son gyrophare bleu et: The raised estate car, its blue light and two-tone siren.
textes.Bicorne, sabre et bottes : la maréchauss: Bicorne hat, sabre and boots: the mounted police on their rounds.
textes.Le « panier à salade » : une caisse ferm: The “salad basket”: a closed box with small windows.
textes.Traction noire et sonnerie : la brigade: A black saloon and a ringing bell: the flying squad arrives.
textes.Pie bleu et blanc, gyrophare unique sur: Blue and white, a single light on the roof.
textes.La caisse basculante des boueux, qui ram: The tipping cart of the street sweepers, who shovel up rubbish and manure.
textes.Benne ouverte et éboueurs sur le marchep: Open body and bin men on the footboard.
textes.Caisse vitrée, colonnes torsadées, plume: Glass body, twisted columns, black plumes and draped horses.
A long black saloon with draped windows.
textes.Le triangle de bois lesté de pierres, qu: The stone-weighted wooden wedge that horses drag through the snow.
A steel blade and a sand spreader at the back.
textes.Coupé, intérieur et impériale : les voya: Front, inside and roof seats: travellers and mail, from one coaching inn to the next.
textes.Le car des colonies de vacances, galerie: The holiday-camp coach, with a luggage rack on the roof.
textes.Charrettes, diligences, puits, lampes à: Carts, stagecoaches, wells, oil lamps and hand pumps.
Gasworks and pipes under the streets.
textes.Les premières lignes de voitures publiqu: The first lines of horse-drawn public carriages.
textes.Locomotives à vapeur, gares et briques i: Steam locomotives, stations and industrial brick.
textes.Captages, usines d'eau et grands collect: Water intakes, waterworks and main sewers; zoos and grand hotels.
textes.Immeubles haussmanniens, gares monumenta: Haussmann buildings, grand stations, modern hospitals.
textes.Puits de pétrole, raffineries, aciéries: Oil wells, refineries, steelworks; steam fire engines.
textes.Centraux téléphoniques, lignes de cuivre: Telephone exchanges, copper lines and trams.
textes.Premières centrales au charbon et lignes: The first coal power stations and power lines.

textes.Aérodromes, garages, usines automobiles,: Airfields, garages, car factories, motor fire pumps.
textes.Art déco, stations-service, autobus, jaz: Art deco, petrol stations, buses, jazz and the national grid.
textes.Autoroutes, aéroports, piscines, camping: Motorways, airports, swimming pools, camping and the first modern buildings.
textes.Maisons et immeubles modernes, supermarc: Modern houses and flats, supermarkets, helicopters, sewage treatment.
textes.Centrales nucléaires, tours, hypermarché: Nuclear power stations, towers, hypermarkets and housing estates.

textes.Fibre optique, centres de données, centr: Optical fibre, data centres, solar farms.

textes.Vendange à la main (hottes et paniers): Grape picking by hand (hods and baskets)
textes.Alambics de cuivre : fruits → eaux-de-vi: Copper stills: fruit → brandies and liqueurs.
textes.Argile moulée et cuite → tuiles canal, p: Moulded and fired clay → barrel, flat and interlocking roof tiles.
textes.Balles du centre de tri → acier, alumini: Bales from the sorting centre → reusable steel, aluminium, paper and plastic.
textes.Bassins en eau courante et écloserie. Le: Running-water ponds and hatchery. The fish eat grain (pellets).
textes.Boîtes en fer-blanc stérilisées (procédé: Sterilised tin cans (Appert's process): vegetables, fruit and ready meals.
textes.Café vert grillé, moulu et ensaché pour: Green coffee roasted, ground and bagged for grocers.
textes.Calcaire cuit au bois → chaux, le mortie: Limestone burnt with wood → lime, the masons' mortar before cement.
textes.Cale de lancement et grue : bois puis ac: Slipway and crane: wood then steel → ships (export). On the waterfront.
textes.Cellules lithium-ion et packs pour les v: Lithium-ion cells and packs for electric cars and power storage.
textes.Chai, pressoir et rangs de vigne sur les: Wine store, press and rows of vines on the hillsides. Grapes picked by hand before 1975.
textes.Chalet, chaudron de cuivre et cave d'aff: Chalet, copper cauldron and ageing cellar: milk → wheels of Gruyère and tomme.
textes.Corral et kotas. Les rennes paissent le: Corral and kotas. Reindeer graze the lichen of boreal regions.
textes.Enclos de pierre et abri de tonte. Laine: Stone pens and shearing shed. Fine wool and meat, in the mountains.
textes.Feuilles séchées, roulées et coupées → c: Leaves dried, rolled and cut → cigars and cigarettes (sold for export).
textes.Fosses à tan au bord de l'eau : peaux →: Tan pits by the water: hides → leather for shoes, saddles and bags.
textes.Hangar de tri, chambre froide et arbres: Sorting shed, cold store and fruit trees (citrus in warm climates). Beehives for pollination.
textes.Hautes perches de houblon (pour les bras: Tall hop poles (for breweries) and a wooden tobacco barn.
textes.Mas, oliviers centenaires et moutons dan: Farmhouse, century-old olive trees and sheep between the rows. Mediterranean climates.
textes.Moulin à cannes, chaudières et colonnes: Cane mill, boilers and stills: cane → brown sugar and rum.
textes.Pressoirs, cuves et chais : raisin → vin: Presses, vats and cellars: grapes → bottled wine.
textes.Procédé Haber-Bosch : gaz naturel + azot: Haber-Bosch process: natural gas + nitrogen from the air → ammonium nitrate for the fields.
textes.Ruches au milieu des prés et des vergers: Hives among meadows and orchards, a honey house to extract the honey.
textes.Sucrerie de canne et rhumerie: Cane sugar mill and rum distillery
textes.Séchoirs, hangars et cueilleurs. Café, c: Drying floors, sheds and pickers. Coffee, cocoa, tea or sugar cane depending on the climate (subtropical, tropical).
textes.Torréfaction, broyage et conchage : caca: Roasting, grinding and conching: cocoa + sugar + milk → bars and sweets.
textes.Étables ouvertes et mares. Lait de buffl: Open barns and ponds. Buffalo milk (mozzarella) and meat.
textes.Établis d'horlogers sous les grandes fen: Watchmakers' benches under tall windows: movements, cases and dials → watches (export).
